description.value: The Tong Louie Family YMCA is a full-service community centre in Surrey's Newton neighbourhood offering fitness, aquatics, child care, and a wide range of community programs. As a YMCA facility with pool and fitness amenities, it serves residents across the South Surrey and Delta corridor. The location is wheelchair accessible per OSM records.
